revise.statement: Project identity: commander — 'the complete solution for node.js command-line programs' (README:8, package.json:4); declarative CLI framework: options, arguments, subcommands, automated help, hooks, executable subcommands
Snapshot: v14.0.3 at HEAD bf35c5f (2026-02-02), clean tree; release commit 8247364 '14.0.3' 2026-01-31; top 2 commits are dependabot devDep bumps touching only package-lock.json
Zero runtime dependencies; lib/ uses only Node builtins (events, child_process, path, fs, process) and internal modules
evidence: grep require( in lib/ (13 matches, all builtins/internal)

revise.statement: Node >=20 required (engines); CI matrix node 20/22/24 x ubuntu/windows/macos; jest with coverage + eslint/prettier/tsd/tsc checks; CodeQL workflow
Strict-by-default parsing: unknown option error + suggestion, excess arguments error (v13 breaking), negative numbers accepted when unambiguous (v14), opt-outs allowUnknownOption/allowExcessArguments

Parse architecture: Command extends EventEmitter; options handled via option:/optionEnv: events; option values stored with source tracking (default/env/cli/implied/config); parseOptions() single-pass state machine splitting operands/unknown; recursive _parseCommand dispatch; promise-chained hooks

Help system fully extensible: Help class style*/format* methods, configureHelp/configureOutput, help groups (14.0.0), color conventions (NO_COLOR/FORCE_COLOR/CLICOLOR_FORCE), stripColor; color off by default (style methods identity)
Executable subcommands: child_process.spawn, extension probing (.js/.ts/.tsx/.mjs/.cjs), legacy name fallback, inspector port increment, signal forwarding, Windows ENOENT/EACCES handling
Typings: hand-maintained typings/index.d.ts (1113 lines) + esm.d.mts; JSDoc-based JS type checking (tsconfig.js.json); tsd type tests; TS import tests; ESM wrapper esm.mjs with exports map
Test suite exists and is extensive: ~91 test files covering parse/options/args/help/arguments/hooks/subcommands/executables/typings; fixtures with extension matrix

evidence: CI config .github/workflows/tests.yml runs npm test + npm run check

revise.statement: Release policy: semver; majors ~every 6 months; node minimum raised at LTS EOL; current line gets all updates, previous major gets security-only 12 months; 13.x EOL 2026-05-18
Maintainers: John Gee (shadowspawn) and Abe Tomoaki (abetomo); sponsorship links in package-support.json; Tidelift security contact
Ecosystem scale (downloads/dependents/advisories): web verification unavailable this session; search snippet places commander among packages with >10M weekly downloads
evidence: web_search snippet (dev.to risk-map audit listing commander)

revise.statement: Backward-compat debt: 10+ documented deprecations (docs/deprecated.md), some held since v7; removal happens at majors; v13 removed multi-char short flags + default export, v12 removed CJS default import

No corrosion found: ESM wrapper (avoids dual-package hazard), EventEmitter design (public custom-listener API), process.exit control flow (documented, exitOverride escape hatch), color-by-hooks (zero-dep constraint) are deliberate evolutions/constraints, not corrosion

hypotheses.statement: commander.js is a mature library at a maintenance plateau: feature-complete for its scope, zero runtime dependencies, heavily tested; this snapshot requires no intervention

Any future change must respect invariants: zero runtime deps, strict-by-default errors, EventEmitter parse pipeline, dual typings maintenance, compat windows (13.x until 2026-05-18); the only genuine unknowns are external evidence gaps (ecosystem state, CI green-ness)
